title: [master]Sales Quote for Subscription Billing report layout incorrectly includes the Quote Variant Lines in Subscription Totals in the Switzerland version.
summary: Quote variant lines are no longer counted in subscription totals on the Sales Quote for Subscription Billing, a problem reported in the Switzerland version. The change is made in the Sales Line table across 12 base app layers and in the Subscription Billing Sales Subscription Line table.
key_points: Quote variant lines are excluded from subscription totals on sales quotes
Sales Line table updated in the W1 layer and 11 localization layers, including CH
Sales Subscription Line table in Subscription Billing also updated
Tests added in Sales Service Commitment Test and the CH Quote Management test
quote: Sales Quote for Subscription Billing report layout incorrectly includes the Quote Variant Lines in Subscription Totals in the Switzerland version.
